name: Hubbell Incorporated
old_description: Manufactures electrical and utility solutions including switches, sockets, and panel board components.
about:
Hubbell Incorporated is headquartered in Shelton, Connecticut, and traces its origins to 1888. The company has operated continuously since its founding, evolving into a manufacturer of electrical and utility solutions for critical infrastructure.

The company produces a broad range of electrical components including switches, sockets, panel board parts, wiring devices, connection and control solutions, lighting and controls for harsh industrial environments, and datacom products for telecommunications and data centers. Its portfolio also covers utility and communications infrastructure solutions.

Hubbell serves diverse markets such as commercial construction, data centers, healthcare facilities, industrial manufacturing, original equipment manufacturers, fuels, power and utility, renewables, residential, water and gas distribution, and telecommunications. Customers include contractors, utilities, OEMs, and facility operators seeking reliable electrical infrastructure.

The company emphasizes trusted solutions for critical infrastructure, integrating sustainability across its products and operations. It offers a competitor cross-reference tool to simplify part identification and has been recognized among the World's Most Ethical Companies. These elements reflect its focus on safety, reliability, and long-term performance.
